title: AQUAmetaverse Marketplaces
tagline: AquaMetaverse marketplaces propose creators and visitors a localized experience based on the location chosen on map which represent some Seaside or Water front virtual 3d location of the World
description:
Metaverse GAMEFI Platform oriented for the water sports entertainment market and audience. Features Virtual lands Seaside , near a river or lake waterfront. 
We aim to provide a free avatar and waterfront vland on the AquaMetaverse to each visitor wallet passing KYC, and those who are owners of our Special Edition NFTs.

AquaMetaverse Gaming aspects aim to offer Minigames related to Water sports games such as SUP Paddle boarding, Surfing, Wind airwing foil, Kayak, Boating, Fishing , and alike. 
An important aspect of what we create is the play to learn experience and message we want to pass, mini-games aim to teach about the plastic pollution problem and potential solutions for the waters and coasts worldwide.

Defi part of the platform features such as dashboards with market prices in realtime,  buying coins, DEFI wallets, DEFI Aggregator with capabilities such as finding best rates on Swap, Liquidity pools, Staking NFTs, Loans.

The concept of REFI its been explored on this Hackathon as part of the aggregator Dashboards

When visiting AquaMetaverse virtual 3d World , localized NFT Marketplaces are featured where local creators, designers of water sport items, artists and musicians can feature their NFTs.  

This is a similar experience you get in real life when on a vacation at some Seaside destination around the world. If you visit Hawaii , the marketplace features Hawaiian related NFTs and from creators of the region. 

We want to recreate the experience and integrate VR marketplace options, live video interaction with store owners via their Metaverse shop.

AquaMetaverse marketplaces propose creators and visitors a localized experience based on the location chosen on map which represent some Seaside or Water front virtual 3d location of the World
how_its_made:
The basic Metaverse game is a mix of Web2 , Web3 , Unity 3d, C, 3D models , 3D maps, NFT lands, Dynamic NFTs, Solidity, MongoDB, Python, PHP, Javascript, NextJS, REACT , ProvenDB , NodeJS, Phaser, Moralis.io , Tatum.io , IPFS , Filecoin 

Considering how to use and insert tech stack from sponsors in progress.
